title: Frappe ERPNext 12.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 12.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in the Accounts module dashboard chart source. This flaw allows authenticated users, including portal users or users without roles, to access general ledger balance history for any company by sending crafted requests without proper permission checks.
